canvasFindings: W035 (nnxyz good morning nifty randoomdle): The correctly composited image over the white canvas reveals a fully realized landscape in light, saturated color. The sky is a clear cyan-blue with soft pink-and-white cloud forms. Foliage on the left and right trees is vivid green with visible looping white contour lines tracing leaves and branches. The water in the foreground is pale blue-green with horizontal looping lines describing ripples. Rolling hills recede in muted green and grey-blue. The looping white lines are clearly visible throughout as a unifying surface texture, not merely a dark or opaque overlay. The earlier description of 'looping white lines' and 'foliage, water, and sky alike' is directionally correct but understates the chromatic richness: the image is bright and open, not tonally neutral. The pink cloud passages and the yellow-green light on the distant hills are prominent features the prior prose omits. The channel reads as a calm, reflective body of water rather than a generic 'open distance.' No figure is present. Membership in Chapter 4 is fully supported by the image.

title: Bodies, Signs and Scenes
question: When do surroundings become as prominent as the figures within them?
introduction: A solitary body leads into figures sharing space with signs, other bodies and increasingly prominent surroundings. Compare gesture with the marks that continue beyond a figure. Changes in scale, grouping and setting offer different ways into these scenes. The later works invite attention to light, water and open landscape as well as recognizable characters.
closing: Look back from the final scene to an earlier body. At which point did you begin following the surrounding space as closely as the figure?

chapters.title: One Figure, Open Space
chapters.introduction: Three figures stand or stride in clear space. Each body is the primary subject, yet each is already wrapped, labeled, or accompanied by loose marks trailing nearby.

stops.whyHere: The striding, coil-wrapped figure with scattered dots above it opens the gallery: a single body in clear teal space, already partly unraveling upward.
stops.title: nnxyz #8

stops.whyHere: A clothed, spiked figure stands centered on black; the shirt lettering introduces text as part of the body's surface for the first time.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz #8 strides on teal with loose dots above; nnxyz nifty summer night ink plants itself on black, replacing scattered marks with a glowing halo that clings closer to the form.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty summer night ink

stops.whyHere: Arms flung wide and feet lifted, this figure suspends itself in a teal field crowded with music notes and repeated text, the body still legible but the surrounding marks now equally active.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty summer night ink's halo stays tight to the head; here the radiating marks — wavy lines, lettering, notes — spread across the whole field, loosening the figure's grip on the space.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty summer dance ink

chapters.title: Body as Label
chapters.introduction: Four works where the figure wears or carries its own identifying text or object. The label and the body occupy the same surface on equal terms.

stops.whyHere: A stick-limbed figure holds a tilted bottle while glasses and shirt announce the work's own context; the spilling bubble shapes pull the eye away from the body.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty summer dance ink's text floats free around the figure; here text is printed on the body itself and the held object extends the figure's reach outward.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty summer ink

stops.whyHere: Pizza slices crown the head and repeat as a shirt emblem; the figure is so thoroughly marked by the food motif that it becomes the figure's identity rather than a detail.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty summer ink carries its label in hand; pizza pizza pizza day wears it on the head and chest simultaneously, collapsing the distance between figure and sign.
stops.title: pizza pizza pizza day

stops.whyHere: Auction-house names and art-world labels crowd every margin around a blocky head; text and image compete for the same surface without either winning.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: pizza pizza pizza day's labels are cartoonish and cheerful; nnxyz #66's handwritten tags carry a different charge, pressing against the figure as credential or critique rather than decoration.
stops.title: nnxyz #66

stops.whyHere: Pink lettering sits where eyes would be, turning the face into a billboard; the crosshatched background crackles with competing marks that match the face's own texture.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz #66's text surrounds the figure from outside; here lettering replaces a facial feature entirely, and the background noise rises to meet the face's own density.
stops.title: nnxyz randoomdle with cap

chapters.title: More Than One Figure
chapters.introduction: Works where two or more figures share the surface. Differences in size, proximity, and gesture produce relationships that range from announcement to collision.

stops.whyHere: An oversized head lunges toward a tiny sign-holding companion; the scale gap between them gives the scene an uneasy, lopsided weight.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz randoomdle with cap shows a single face overwhelmed by marks; pizza pizza pizza pizza day introduces a second, much smaller figure, making scale itself the subject.
stops.title: pizza pizza pizza pizza day

stops.whyHere: Two face-forms — one small and downturned, one large and tooth-baring — share a warm yellow field with a wedge pressed between them, holding opposing moods in the same space.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: pizza pizza pizza pizza day's figures are separated by scale; pizza pizza day 's two faces are separated by mood, pressed into the same warm field without resolving their difference.
stops.title: pizza pizza day

stops.whyHere: A large flat-black head and two small clustered figures, one thrusting a numbered card upward, stage an announcement across a spare white ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: pizza pizza day 's faces share a dense, scribbled field; nnxyz 300 nifties strips the ground bare, making the scale contrast between large head and small figures starker and more deliberate.
stops.title: nnxyz 300 nifties

stops.whyHere: Three rounded figures in green, blue, and pink stand side by side, each marked with a letter; their varied poses and expressions prevent the group from reading as a single unit.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz 300 nifties's small figures cluster below a dominant head; nnxyz 100 nifties gives three figures equal size and equal ground, distributing attention evenly across the trio.
stops.title: nnxyz 100 nifties

stops.whyHere: Figures stack and overlap above a blazing light source; smaller forms dissolve into the glow below, so the crowd reads as accumulation fading toward light.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz 100 nifties's three figures stand distinct on grey; nnxyz 200 nifties multiplies and merges them, the radiating light pulling bodies toward dissolution rather than separation.
stops.title: nnxyz 200 nifties

stops.whyHere: Three figures share a pink field without clearly interacting; yellow dashes scatter across all of them, refusing to settle into background or foreground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz 200 nifties's figures converge on a single light source; nnxyz #12's three hold their own spaces on a flat pink ground, the scattered dashes connecting them without implying relationship.
stops.title: nnxyz #12

chapters.title: Figure Under Competing Marks
chapters.introduction: Works where the face or body is built from layered marks, text, and color until the image is densely packed. The figure remains locatable but no longer dominates.

stops.whyHere: A grinning central figure, sad-faced hearts, blue teardrops, and a small capped figure to the right send competing signals that sit unresolved across the lavender field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz #12's figures coexist without drama; nnxyz #35 loads the same multi-figure format with contradictory signals — bared teeth beside deflated hearts — that refuse to settle.
stops.title: nnxyz #35

stops.whyHere: Two figures press together at center, a red stroke cutting through the larger one; the image feels suspended mid-collision, neither resolved nor broken.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz #35's figures are spread across the field; nnxyz #34 compresses two bodies into close contact, and the red diagonal stroke introduces a physical force the earlier work kept at bay.
stops.title: nnxyz #34

stops.whyHere: A goggle-eyed figure holds the center while handwritten text crowds every edge; the warm pink corner reads as a quieter margin against the surrounding noise.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz #34's pressure is physical, a stroke cutting through form; nnxyz #64's pressure is textual, words pressing against the figure from all sides without touching it.
stops.title: nnxyz #64

stops.whyHere: Rectangular frames stack into a face built from competing symbols; red hand shapes at the lower corners pull outward while the dark ground compresses everything inward.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz #64's text crowds the figure from outside; nnxyz #27 builds the face itself from competing frames and symbols, so the pressure is structural rather than surrounding.
stops.title: nnxyz #27

stops.whyHere: A glowing yellow-gold mass anchored by dense black lines is surrounded by four open-fingered forms reaching from multiple edges; the image feels like grasping or release rather than stillness.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz #27's face is built from rectangular frames; nnxyz #30 dissolves the face into a glowing mass, and the reaching hand-forms replace the earlier work's compressed geometry with outward reach.
stops.title: nnxyz #30

stops.whyHere: A tightly hatched rectangular structure on the right and a looser scatter of colored loops on the left hold the image in tension between containment and open drift; no figure is clearly present.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz #30's hand-forms reach outward from a central glow; nnxyz #6 removes the figure entirely, leaving only the contrast between a pressured bounded form and a wandering scatter of marks.
stops.title: nnxyz #6

chapters.title: World Without Figure
chapters.introduction: Two works where the human form either merges with its surroundings or disappears entirely. The marks that described faces and bodies now describe water, creature, and open landscape.

stops.whyHere: Luminous gold and cyan curves rise from wave-like marks on a dark blue field; creature and water are described by the same short angular strokes, so their boundary stays open.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz #6 holds tension between a bounded structure and loose marks; nnxyz Smaug on the Water  carries that same tension into a subject where the boundary between form and surrounding element is equally difficult to fix.
stops.title: nnxyz Smaug on the Water

stops.whyHere: Looping white contour lines trace every surface — vivid green foliage, pale blue-green water, pink-tinged clouds, and receding grey-green hills — giving the whole landscape a single restless texture. No figure is present; the same mark that elsewhere described a body here describes only light, water, and open sky.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz Smaug on the Water still offers a recognizable subject rising from dark water; nnxyz good morning nifty randoomdle replaces that dark ground with a fully lit, color-saturated landscape where the looping line-work now moves across cyan sky, pink clouds, and bright foliage without any focal form to anchor it.
stops.title: nnxyz good morning nifty randoomdle
